no_target_yet.statement: Fix an integer $M\ge1$. In each of the size, perimeter and largest-part ensembles, the sum over partitions with every multiplicity at most $M$ is asymptotic to $e^\gamma/(\zeta(M+1)n)$, where $\zeta(s)=\sum_{j\ge1}j^{-s}$ for $s>1$. In particular, this answers the distinct-parts question in \cite[\S6.2]{lsv1,lsj} for size, and gives the corresponding limits for perimeter and largest part.

no_target_yet.statement: Fix $\beta>1$. Write $B_\beta=\prod_{d\ge1}(1-p_d^{-\beta})^{-1}$ and $D_\beta=\prod_{d\ge2}(1-d^{-\beta})^{-1}$. With weights $\prod_d p_d^{-\beta m_d(\lambda)}$, each of the three ensemble sums is asymptotic to $B_\beta p_n^{-\beta}$. With weights $\prod_d d^{-\beta m_d(\lambda)}$, the size and perimeter sums both tend to $D_\beta$, and the largest-part sum restricted to partitions without ones is asymptotic to $D_\beta n^{-\beta}$. This treats the range $\beta>1$ of \cite[\S6.1]{lsv1,lsj}.
no_target_yet.title: The Lagarias–Sun size and perimeter conjectures for reciprocal supernorms

no_target_yet.statement:
For the reciprocal-norm sum $W_{\mathrm{per}}(n)$ over partitions of perimeter $n\ge1$,
\[
 0\le n-W_{\mathrm{per}}(n)\le H_{n-1},\qquad
 W_{\mathrm{per}}(n)=n-H_{n-1}+O\!\left(\frac{(\log n)^2}{n}\right),
\]
where $H_j=\sum_{d=1}^j1/d$ with $H_0=0$. In particular $W_{\mathrm{per}}(n)=n-\log n-\gamma+o(1)$, answering the leading-term question of \cite[\S1 and Appendix~A.1]{lsj} and giving the logarithmic correction.
no_target_yet.title: The Lagarias–Sun size and perimeter conjectures for reciprocal supernorms
